This appears to be a CBP ruling concerning a "Hydro Dip Mini Pumpkin Kit," a craft kit that includes small artificial pumpkins to be decorated by dipping in water with paint. I recall the kit contains foam or plastic mini pumpkins, paints, and accessories. Seasonal Halloween decorations fall under heading 9505. Festive articles are classified in 9505.90.60 (other festive, carnival or other entertainment articles). The kit would be classified as a set under GRI 3(b), with the pumpkins giving it its essential character, so the result is 9505.90.6000.
